scope: Integration and count adjudication of the independent 20-case audit, with direct read of fixture ownership/cleanup, deployed binding configuration, intended D1 documentation and nearest-overlap paths. Hashes below independently rechecked; no test body, SQL or SUT execution.

closest_overlap_adjudication.basis: D213 tests native SqlCursor._obj/raw projection. E209 tests independently implemented D1 __d1Shape plus first/raw after JSON binding transport. Their outward duplicate-column rule is shared, but either independent conversion path can regress while the other passes. No extra credit per method or primitive.

contract_adjudication: Celld explicitly documents readonly counter resets, primary-only sessions and stable bookmarks, exec statement counts, and database_id/name identity precedence. These are intended source-cut contracts rather than uncommitted accidental behavior; not asserted as universal Cloudflare behavior. Correct scalar/value oracles were not weakened.
runtime_prerequisites: UNRUN. No execution authorization or runtime credit granted. Genuine direct-celld deployment and executable provenance, fresh isolated store, enforced 30-second request/700-second wave and CPU/RSS/disk/output limits, and mandatory owned teardown remain external prerequisites. Missing evidence is BLOCKED, not PASS.

case_verdicts.reason: Independent immutable bound-statement objects, rebind replacement and reusability; T011 instead tests a live native cursor under concurrent cached-query reuse.
Repeated numbered placeholders bind by parameter index, including reorder and null, rather than occurrence position.
D1 public boolean normalization and JSON scalar transport with SQL type checks. D212 uses native DO SQL values and cannot detect this separate codec.
Bind-time ArrayBuffer/typed-view copies, typed element-to-byte truncation and JSON byte-array BLOB results. D212/T019 use native byte windows and ArrayBuffer outputs; the conversion rules differ.
run/all alias parity across single-row RETURNING and SELECT result envelopes; D214 native cursor exhaustion does not cover either client method.
first row versus selected scalar versus SQL NULL versus absent row on the public D1 result contract; no cursor-reuse claim.
raw selected-column order and headings-only empty results; live native raw cursor position tests do not exercise D1 columnNames packing.
Ordinary SQL column labels remain own enumerable properties, including __proto__; explicitly intended Object.fromEntries shaping, not malformed input or prototype mutation.

Closest cross-wave overlap: D213 has the same outward duplicate-name contract. Recommend separate credit because SqlCursor._obj/raw and D1 __d1Shape/first/raw are independently implemented paths with distinct native-versus-JSON result boundaries. This is one case, not three methods of credit.
Successful D1 batch creates schema, performs dependent reads/writes and returns position-associated results. It claims neither rollback nor concurrent-observer atomicity.
Per-item D1 batch metadata attribution with varying insert rowids and write counts. Explicit D1Meta snapshot intent and public per-query metadata back the oracle; read resets are celld-documented.
D1-specific multi-statement tail walker and count/duration envelope, comments and complete final statement without semicolon. D216/D217 ingest exposes a different remainder/count contract.
D1 exec discards RETURNING row sets while completing multirow insert/update effects before response; D219 uses ingest with read-only row-producing statements.

Cross-dispatch readonly mutation counters reset after a known write, plus deliberately pinned local-primary metadata. The reset is an explicit celld compatibility difference, not accidental implementation behavior.
changed_db distinguishes schema creation/removal from a valid unmatched update, independently of row count; storage.rs expressly describes the intended schema-cookie correction.
first retains one valid RETURNING receipt while all mutations complete; D214 drains every native receipt explicitly. The case does not impose RETURNING order.
Independent session query bookmark advancement, initial constraints and resume using the supplied token; stable primary token is celld-documented. No replica or cross-request capability claim.
Separate session.batch bookmark-advancement path plus committed base/session data visibility; E217 only exercises query advancement.
Production config identity aliasing and isolation through three legitimate D1 bindings; differs from native storage-scope isolation and service KV namespaces.
Documented absent-id fallback converges with an explicit equal identity; it tests configuration precedence, beyond E219 explicit-id aliasing.
